title: iTutorGroup to Pay $365000 to Settle EEOC Discriminatory Hiring Suit
supports_claim: EEOC reported allegations that configured software automatically rejected more than 200 older applicants and a $365000 settlement.
limitations: Settlement announcement reports allegations and relief but does not publish a technical audit or causal model analysis.

title: Navigating Employment Discrimination in AI and Automated Systems - Testimony of Gary D. Friedman
supports_claim: The testimony records the reported Amazon recruiting prototype and cautions against assuming all automated screening is AI.
limitations: Witness testimony is not an adjudicative finding and relies on external reporting for the Amazon account.

title: U.S. EEOC and U.S. Department of Justice Warn against Disability Discrimination
supports_claim: EEOC states that algorithmic employment tools can screen out qualified people with disabilities and recommends accommodation processes.
limitations: United States guidance does not determine legal obligations in Vietnam or the European Union.

title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework 1.0
supports_claim: NIST structures voluntary AI risk management around Govern Map Measure and Manage functions.
limitations: The framework is voluntary and is neither legal classification nor compliance certification.

title: Law 134/2025/QH15 on Artificial Intelligence
supports_claim: The official publication supplies the governing Vietnam AI Law text for use-case classification and obligations.
limitations: Exact duties depend on product role workflow and current implementing instruments and require counsel review.

title: Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg high-risk AI list
supports_claim: The official decision supplies Vietnam's current list used to assess whether an AI use case is high-risk.
limitations: The complete workflow must be compared with the full list; title metadata alone cannot establish classification.

title: AI Act implementation and high-risk timeline
supports_claim: The Commission identifies employment among high-risk areas and states the current application timeline for those systems.
limitations: Timeline and implementing guidance can change and provider or deployer role remains fact-specific.
